comment: XDRIVE configurations and what `xray run -test` of Xray-core v26.11.9 says of each: "ok" or a substring of its error. "ours" records a deliberate difference of the parser, "core" a refusal when the core starts (a substring of its error). Rechecked by scripts/check-config-verdicts.py in scripts/check-xdrive-interop.sh.
